name: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire
description: An interactive Arabic trivia game with 15 questions, three lifelines, a countdown timer, and full offline play.
longDescription: A trivia game I built from scratch with React and TypeScript, inspired by the classic Who Wants to Be a Millionaire format. It features 15 questions across varied topics, three lifelines (50:50, audience poll, walk away), a 30-second SVG circular countdown, and Tone.js sound effects. It ships as a PWA, so the full game plays offline, with a responsive RTL layout tuned for mobile.

name: Salam
description: A daily spiritual reflections app with Athkar and Quranic verses, built with Flutter for Android and iOS.
longDescription: Salam presents daily spiritual reflections, Athkar, and Quranic verses in a calm, Arabic-first interface. I built it with Flutter and GetX for cross-platform support, with full RTL layout, smooth navigation, and scheduled daily notifications.

name: Salam
description: Salam rebuilt from scratch as a native Android app in Kotlin: fully offline, with zero network permissions.
longDescription: I rebuilt Salam from scratch as a native Android app, going beyond the original Flutter version. It carries over 500 pages of Arabic content on the MVVM architecture with a Material 3 look. The app runs fully offline and requests no network permissions, protecting privacy and performance, with complete font customization and instant WhatsApp sharing.

name: Athkarix
description: A daily Athkar and supplications app with Quranic verses, built with Flutter.
longDescription: Athkarix gathers daily supplications (Athkar) and Quranic verses in a simple, content-focused interface. I built it with Flutter so it runs on both Android and iOS.

name: Developer Portfolio
description: This website: a multilingual portfolio showcasing my projects, with dark mode and PWA support.
longDescription: The site you are browsing: a fully responsive, five-language portfolio presenting my work and journey. I built it with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, with light and dark themes, SEO optimization, PWA support, and a right-to-left Arabic interface.

name: Voices of Truth
description: A multilingual directory of Islamic scholars worldwide, with search and filtering by category, country, and language.
longDescription: Voices of Truth brings profiles of Islamic scholars and preachers worldwide together in one place. I built it with Next.js Server Components for fast performance, supporting Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR). It offers search and filtering by category, country, and language, with a responsive interface, Framer Motion animations, and light and dark themes.

name: Khwater
description: Arabic spiritual and intellectual reflections in a calm reading experience that works offline.
longDescription: Khwater collects Arabic spiritual and intellectual writings inspired by Islamic values, presented in a modern interface designed for comfortable reading. I migrated it fully from Flutter to Next.js through a structured, multi-phase plan, focusing on performance, offline support, and SEO. It includes bookmarks, search, light and dark themes, and offline reading.

name: Huawei Router Control
description: A web tool for managing Huawei routers: settings, network monitoring, and automation.
longDescription: A management tool designed specifically for Huawei routers. It provides advanced controls, monitoring, and automation through a simple web interface for adjusting router settings, watching network performance, and applying security measures. Built with Node.js, Express, and React.

name: New Muslim Stories
description: A multilingual platform telling real stories of people who embraced Islam, with search and daily featured stories.
longDescription: A content-driven platform presenting real stories of people who embraced Islam: their journeys, backgrounds, and moments of guidance. I built it with Next.js and TypeScript in a calm, spiritual tone, supporting Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR). It includes filtering by country or background, search, a daily featured story, and gentle Framer Motion animations, with special care for accessibility.

name: Bassaer (بصائر)
description: A digital reading platform turning the book Basaer into a fast web app with authentic Arabic typography.
longDescription: Bassaer brings Dr. Haitham Talaat's book, Insights into the Universe, Life, and Religion, to the web. I converted the 900+ page Arabic PDF into a fast web application with authentic Tajawal typography, using Python and PyMuPDF to extract the book into Markdown chapters rendered through Next.js App Router. The platform offers an elegant parchment-and-ink light and dark reading mode, a sticky table of contents, and smooth chapter navigation.

name: Athkari
description: A native Android rewrite of Athkari in Kotlin: about 2 MB, offline, and ad-free.
longDescription: An Islamic app pairing rich content with a deliberately minimal design. After the first Flutter version, I rewrote it from scratch as native Android in Kotlin with MVVM, choosing a minimalist, ad-free approach that keeps the APK around 2 MB. It works fully offline and includes the daily Fortress of the Muslim (morning, evening, and sleep Athkar), a virtues and formulas guide, and a built-in digital library.

name: Fi Dhilal al-Quran
description: An offline reader for Sayyid Qutb's tafsir with full-text search across 110 surahs and verse highlighting.
longDescription: A complete digital reader for Sayyid Qutb's tafsir, built as a React 19 single-page app. It ships 110 surahs and 305 tafsir sections stored locally with no external API calls. Features include fast full-text search with match scoring, gold-toned light and dark themes, bookmarks with optional Supabase sync, reading history, verse highlighting, Juz navigation, and full offline support; the roughly 18 MB dataset loads on demand.

name: Badeel Atr 2
description: A single-file Arabic guide pairing top-rated men's fragrances with trusted, budget-friendly alternatives.
longDescription: Badeel Atr 2 is a zero-dependency, single-file interactive guide pairing highly rated men's fragrances with a carefully chosen Arabic or budget alternative for each. Ten color-coded fragrance families use programmatically generated SVG bottles, with instant search that normalizes Arabic letters, filtering by family and house, multi-criteria sorting, and color-graded similarity badges for every alternative. State persists in the URL, with JSON-LD structured data, full RTL support, and reduced-motion respect.

name: Shaab Sweets (حلويات الشعب)
description: An offline-first PWA storefront for a 50-year Taiz sweets shop: cart, tracking, and staff admin in the browser.
longDescription: A storefront for Shaab Sweets in Taiz, Yemen, home to fifty years of Yemeni and Adeni sweets. I built it with Vite and vanilla ES modules with zero runtime dependencies, shipping as an installable offline-first PWA: a Workbox service worker precaches the entire store. Cart, multi-step checkout, order tracking, and a staff admin panel run entirely client-side with localStorage persistence, in an Arabic-first RTL design with hand-drawn SVG art and WhatsApp ordering.

name: Assma El-Housna (أسماء الله الحسنى)
description: An Arabic encyclopedia of 100 Names of Allah, explained through Dr. Al-Nabulsi's lectures.
longDescription: An Arabic encyclopedia of the Beautiful Names of Allah, each explained in depth from Dr. Muhammad Ratib Al-Nabulsi's lectures. Built with Next.js static generation, it pre-renders 100 name pages with full Arabic content. It includes Fuse.js fuzzy search, bookmarks saved locally, adjustable font size, light and dark themes, Web Share support, and a complete RTL layout with proper Arabic typography.

name: Istighfar Stories
description: A bilingual platform sharing real and inspired stories about the virtue of Istighfar.
longDescription: Istighfar Stories is a bilingual Arabic and English platform for real-life and inspired stories about seeking forgiveness and its effect on people's lives. I built it with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS; stories are authored in Markdown and presented in a clean reading experience, with full RTL and LTR support, story categories, search, filtering, and light and dark themes.

name: Kunuz (كنوز من السنة النبوية)
description: A free, open-source encyclopedia of 140 authenticated hadiths with smart Arabic search and a tasbeeh counter.
longDescription: Kunuz is an open-source encyclopedia of 140 authenticated Prophetic hadiths curated from Sheikh Mahmoud Al-Masri's series, built with React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4. It offers smart Arabic search with diacritics support, a daily treasure rotation, favorites, an interactive tasbeeh counter with haptic feedback, a daily sunnah checklist with streak tracking, Arabic text-to-speech, and direct sharing to WhatsApp and Telegram.

name: Al Majed Perfumes (الماجد للعطور)
description: A prototype Arabic perfume storefront for a Taiz oud house: catalog, cart, WhatsApp checkout, and admin.
longDescription: Al Majed Perfumes is an Arabic-first e-commerce prototype for an oud and perfume house in Taiz, Yemen, built with Next.js 16, React 19, and TypeScript as an installable PWA. Shoppers browse 17 photographed products, pick size variants, and check out through a locally persisted guest cart that sends one structured WhatsApp message; with the database configured, orders are recorded in PostgreSQL with server-recomputed prices and sequential numbers (MJ-0001). A password-protected admin dashboard manages orders, the catalog, taxonomy, and store settings, with order snapshots so later catalog edits never rewrite filed orders. Product names and images are confirmed; prices, stock, sizes, delivery areas, and some category details are provisional.
